name: release-deployment
summary: Deployments of the named repositories go only to the named environment, each released by a release approver inside a change window.
protects: every deployment of a named repository waits for an independent release approver, whose approval counts only inside the environment's change window
a deployment to any other environment than the named one is refused
deployments are checked as consequences of merges and pushes: a deployment decided directly, not as a consequence of a merge or push, is refused
a deployment of any repository the template was not applied for is refused: this rule applies org-wide, to every agent and every repository, not only to the agent the template grants
the agent's grant covers deployments of the named repositories only
excludes: what the deployment contains: review the merge itself (the coding-to-production template)

a deployment whose environments cannot be told when the merge that starts it is decided is held, not refused; its approval counts only inside a change window, and with no environment it is in none, so the hold expires unless the merge is asked for again once they can be told
deployments started outside PantherClaw (a person pushing, another CI system)
people: bind release_approver yourself (pclaw role bind)

connections: a pc.github connection in enforce mode for the repositories
